ports-free.sql: SELECT ports - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE reservations.station_id = stations.id) AS free FROM stations WHERE id = 'st-1'

reservation-count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM reservations

queue-head.sql: SELECT account FROM queue WHERE station_id = 'st-1' ORDER BY position ASC LIMIT 1

queue-order.sql: SELECT account FROM queue WHERE station_id = 'st-1' ORDER BY position ASC

holder-account.sql: SELECT account FROM reservations WHERE station_id = 'st-1' AND account NOT IN ('seed1_rc') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
